INDEPENDENT N250 CONTACT ATTACK — FINAL WORKER REPORT
Worker: complexity_proof_recon
Date: 9 October 2026, Australia/Brisbane
Status: SCOPED PROOFS COMPLETE; GENERAL CIRCUIT CONTACT GATE UNRESOLVED.
No small-circuit superpolynomial-contact counterfamily obtained. No foundational
breakthrough or novelty claim. No scout reports read; no descendants spawned.

This report gives two direct results outside the exponential linear-realization
route: a sharp contact bound for a factor class containing logarithmic binomials,
and a stronger rational-pullback obstruction allowing growing alphabets and
z-dependent rational readouts. Both are elementary, independently reconstructed
proofs. The first coefficient ingredient is classical; priority of these exact
corollaries has not been established. The general addition problem remains open.

1. PRECISE GATE AND SOURCE INTAKE

Let F have characteristic zero, ell_i(z)=log(1+z/i) in F[[z]], and ord_0 mean
the least nonzero Taylor exponent. N250 asks whether one explicit uniform
polynomial B(n,s,D) bounds ord_0 P(ell) for EVERY nonzero degree-at-most-D
P in F[x_1,...,x_n] computed by an arithmetic circuit of size at most s.
The polynomial's exponent and constants must be independent of P,n,s,D,F.
Arbitrary exact field constants are allowed; a claim about generating rational
evaluation points must not be conflated with their black-box evaluation bit cost.

ASTRA is pinned at 39cdea532f19217f633f70315d92c314a6ce5e3e; OpenAI/math
at fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb. Source trees were read-only.
Read the worker contract, ASTRA 00_START_HERE, AGENTS, complexity topic route,
N246–N250 review notices, N246/N250 frontier metadata, and the exact source
state. The historic updates/AP/package/... paths are logical evidence paths;
the actual state text is web/assets/
e0c060c551efaac24d1aa1d45cba5d805caff51fc16790bebb74996761009476.md.
Its relevant ranges are 47–103 (multiplicity proof), 105–215 (realization),
324–374 (small derivative-span test/prior art), 375–429 (gate/counterexamples),
430–452 (rational pullback). Exact hashes are in source_manifest.json.
These are model-assisted candidate sources; reading them is not certification.

Source correction: OpenAI family 003 is the quasi-Riemann hypothesis manuscript,
not the iterated-integral PIT manuscript. Its scope documentation and paper
introduction concern a uniform 7/8 zero-fr
